comment: Testnet block 1,451,505. Single input spends a 218-sat output whose locking script is 490,001 bytes of repeated 0x6e 0xad (OP_2DROP OP_CHECKSIGVERIFY pairs, ~245,000 forced ECDSA verifications) ending with 0xac (OP_CHECKSIG). NOTE: WhatsOnChain truncates this script to 50,000 bytes in its API/UI; the real prev_locking_script_hex_file was extracted from the raw parent tx supplied by an operator with access to the production utxo external store.
